detail.longDescription: The latest Intuitive+Learn installment is here! 🥳 Folks these days “get” thinking in terms of design system components: buttons, dialogs, form inputs, the humble card…all good stuff. But what happens when you’re out in the “real world” and you’re suddenly having to deal with bespoke # CSS problems beyond the pure landscape of the system? Here’s how to change and add onto component styles in a maintainable way, without messing around in the internals, FTW! 🙌 # WebDev https:// thathtml.blog/2026/08/design-s ystematize-a-component/
